setting: Setting "imageFormat" is set to svg but Illustrator does not honor it. Illustrator rasterizes 8-bit PNG for every value except jpg, so png24 and svg both produce an 8-bit PNG.

structuredWarnings.message: Setting "imageFormat" is set to svg but Illustrator does not honor it. Illustrator rasterizes 8-bit PNG for every value except jpg, so png24 and svg both produce an 8-bit PNG.
